stories.headline: Swinney to cut number of mainland health boards from 11 to two
stories.description: Existing boards could be merged so there would be one for the west and another for the east of Scotland.

stories.headline: Liberals sweep three seats in boost for Carney after trade tensions with US
stories.description: One seat was taken from the Conservatives, indicating public support for the PM after a confrontation with Donald Trump.

stories.headline: What to know about the US primary election in Massachusetts
stories.description: Competitive House races and a Senate showdown will put US Democrats’ progressive-moderate divide to the test.

stories.headline: DRC: Ebola fears grow as children return to school
stories.description: Parents fear school could fuel Ebola spread as authorities shift high-risk pupils to home learning.

stories.headline: Two killed in explosion of ammunition-laden vehicle in Syria’s Idlib
stories.description: Several people injured in the incident that took place in the Idlib countryside, state media reports.
